name: chat_messaging_messages_list
description: The latest messages of a channel (or of one thread), oldest first, or with since the messages posted or edited after that cursor and the ids of those deleted. Either way it gives the cursor to store. A cursor too old is refused as invalid with cursor_expired in its message: list again without one.

thread.description: A thread's first message id: only that thread's replies

since.description: The cursor from the last list, to get only changes since

limit.description: At most this many messages; 50 when left out
